reviews.title: Power efficient psu with great features
reviews.comment: What can I say it gets the job done ,is very quiet and power efficient and works so much better than my old power supply. It also has a lot of features like atx 3.1 and has a lot of other great features, very satisfied with my purchase.

reviews.title: Great budget power supply
reviews.comment: Great performance, easy installation. Only downside is it isn’t open cord so you will have a bunch of cables that you might not need which makes cable management worst but it isn’t that bad you can just cut them off if you know what your doing.
